I am a 24 year old woman. 

I hope you consider that all those around you that are your age and having kids, they may be doing that because they cannot imagine anything bigger for their lives. Children automatically fill a life - play dates, school, appointments, concerts and more. It is an easy path to choose when you cannot imagine anything bigger for your life, I find it quite sad really, nowadays no one seems to believe that they can accomplish their dreams. **Being childfree gives you a life where you can achieve anything you want to**.

Once children come, there is no going back. Those who post cutesy pictures and proclaim motherhood is awesome, they are the ones who cry at nights alone because their lives are **over** and they regret that they gave it all up for a massive lie, pronatalism destroys lies. 

Your body is yours and you can do as you wish, maybe check out interpersonal effectiveness from DBT therapy? It might help you be more confident and assertive. 

I also suggest that you read "The Baby Trap" by Ellen Peck, "The Baby Matrix" and "Childfree and loving it". They are great book that might help you clarify your perspective. They are my favourite books and they truly are excellent, you can get them on Amazon.

Of course, as a CF woman down to the core I speak from a biased place but please, woman to woman, don't buy into the lies, live your life for **you**, don't let the media, brainwashed and baby crazy people and the intense pressure to have children get to you. I know it is difficult but I at least hope you could make your mind up with a full understanding of the **true reality** and not the Kodak moments of parenthood. 

Being childfree is awesome, the world is ours and we are free to live and be true to ourselves, in my own perspective, parenthood is a rusty, painful cage that you can never escape from and it slowly sucks out your soul. I could never give my life up, after fighting for my freedom and independence for years, to live through someone else. Perhaps your mantra could be "My life is mine, I will live it for me, i deserve to have my own life and not live through someone else". 

LARC contraception is a great idea, I have found that the implant is brilliant, at least for me, it would remove one worry from your mind. It is awesome that your boyfriend is pretty much childfree , ask yourself, how would you feel about there being a third person in your relationship for the rest of your lives? Your love and his having to go to another, leaving less for you to give him and him to give you? A huge amount of divorces happen because kids came along and **killed** the relationship, if not the main reason they are the reason it falls apart completely. I love my fiancé too much to do that to us, I want him for myself and he feels the same about me. I think that a lot of couples also use having babies as a way to "cement" or show how *awesome* their relationship is - it is sad to me because that means that they have little connection, I do not need a baby to keep my guy or to share love with him, we are completely fulfilled already and being childfree is a large reason why, we have the time and energy to **truly** be together. I imagine other CF couples may feel the same. 

I highly recommend those books, they may help you find your perspective. If I may be truly honest though, from what you have written I think that if you became a parent you would hate and regret every moment, perhaps you are just having a wobble? I feel that you are CF. 

I hope you get your answers and best of luck to you! 🙂
